title: trigonella officinalis
intro: Trigonella officinalis, commonly known as fenugreek, is a annual herb belonging to the Fabaceae family. The health benefits of fenugreek include its ability to help manage blood sugar levels, improve digestion, and alleviate symptoms of menopause, among other benefits. The therapeutic actions of fenugreek include anti-inflammatory, antioxidant, and anti-diabetic properties, which contribute to its various health benefits. The bioactive constituents of fenugreek include saponins, flavonoids, and alkaloids, such as 4-hydroxyisoleucine and trigonelline, which are responsible for its medicinal properties.
